simple.summary: כּוּשַׁן רִשְׁעָתַיִם (Kûwshan Rishʻâthayim) means Cushan-Rishathajim , a Mesopotamian king First listed occurrence: Judg 3 8.

definitions.full: H3573. Kushan Rishathayim רִשְׁעָתַ֫יִם כּוּשַׁן proper name, masculine king of Aram Naharaim Judg 3:8 (twice in verse); 3:10 (twice in verse); otherwise unknown, ᵐ5 Ξουσαρσαθαιμ , ᵐ5 L Ξουσανρεσαμωθ . כּוֺשָׁרוֺת see [ כּוֺשָׁרָה ] below כָּשַׁר .
definitions.rootNote: apparently from 3572 and the dual of 7564 ; Cushan of double wickedness;
